title: Practice: When: утром, зимой, этим летом

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Ему объясняли: ___ (эта зима) стали по-московски вытирать стены и потолки хлебом, мякишем.
exercises.why: These endings are easily remembered when associated with the adverbs утром, вечером and днём, which are nothing but the instrumental case of the nouns утро, вечер and день. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lesson 30.  ·  «The adverbs утром, вечером and днём … are nothing but the instrumental case of the nouns утро, вечер and день.» — DLI, Lesson 30.
exercises.context: These endings are easily remembered when associated with the adverbs утром, вечером and днём, which are nothing but the instrumental case of the nouns утро, вечер and день. (From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lesson 30)
